heading: What's the difference between ASP.NET MVC and ASP.NET Web API (and how do they relate in ASP.NET Core)?
content: Classic ASP.NET had separate MVC and Web API frameworks -- MVC returned views/HTML, Web API returned data (JSON/XML) over HTTP for clients like SPAs or mobile apps. In ASP.NET Core, the two were unified into one framework: Controllers can return Views or data depending on whether they inherit from Controller or ControllerBase and use attributes like [ApiController].

heading: How do you implement API versioning in a Web API project?
content: The Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Versioning package lets you version via URL segment, query string, or a header. URL-segment versioning (e.g. /api/v1/products) is the most discoverable and commonly used approach for public APIs.
